input: I am a new employee who joined the organisation last month and I am trying to understand the full scope of HR policies that apply to me including leave entitlements, medical benefits, travel claim procedures, and any other allowances or benefits that I should be aware of as a permanent full-time staff member working in the operations department. Could you please provide a comprehensive overview?
expected: Please refer to the HR Policy Handbook for a full overview of entitlements and benefits.
